title.zh: Australia’s financial watchdog seeks stiffer rules for crypto exchanges ahead of licensing deadline
title.en: Australia’s financial watchdog seeks stiffer rules for crypto exchanges ahead of licensing deadline

current_state.zh: Australia's ASIC proposed stricter standards requiring crypto exchanges and digital asset custodians to safeguard customer funds, ensure transparent trading and meet financial requirements, with rules taking effect in April 2027 and licensing applications due by Oct. 7, 2027.
